description: An AI-powered research and note-taking assistant that creates personalized notebooks from uploaded documents and sources.
auth_notes: Google API keys via Google AI Studio or Google Cloud OAuth2 for the underlying Gemini models and developer platform.
credential_notes: Developers can sign up for Google AI Studio self-serve and obtain free-tier API credentials with generous usage limits.
api_notes: Provides programmatic access to Gemini models and developer tools via Google AI Studio / Gemini API, though NotebookLM itself lacks a dedicated public API.
mcp_notes: No official MCP server published directly for NotebookLM by Google; community integrations vary.
rationale: While the underlying Gemini API is fully buildable and self-serve free, NotebookLM as a specific product does not feature a dedicated public CRUD API for notebooks.

evidence.note: Gemini API integration using API keys or Google client libraries
Free tier and self-serve API keys available via Google AI Studio

open_questions: Whether Google plans to release a dedicated public API or MCP server specifically for NotebookLM notebooks.
